name: index-degraded-single-folder
title: Allow a degraded single-folder mode instead of index errors
description: When a folder is opened without a complete project workspace, do not paint index errors over the editor; offer an explicit opt-out and a quiet degraded state.
creator: deviousprophet
notes: Fragment-workspace mode. Root cause: validateWorkspace already computes hasDefinitions but uses it only for missingDefinition, so a definition-free index still emits brokenReference/destMismatch (error) and duplicateShortName (error) for every reference and repeated AR path. Plan: crossFileRules setting (auto|always|never, default auto) gating brokenReference, destMismatch and cross-file duplicateShortName; auto suppresses them when the index has no definitions; no-workspace-folder windows behave the same; status bar reports the mode with a cycling command; no dialog. Default auto is behaviour-preserving for complete projects. Ships with the v0.6.1 tasks; shared release steps live in 11-04-validation-false-positives/implement.md section 8. Planning only - no src changes in this phase.
